newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian overnight rates end steady 23.125 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian overnight rates end steady 23.125 pct.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates on Friday closed unchanged from Thursday's finish in busy trading, dealers said. After opening at 23 percent overnight rates climbed to 23.125 percent where they ended.
"Most deals were concluded at 23.125 percent," said Sandor Szatmari of Unicbank. "The market was fairly active."

Overnight rates remained firm today because banks continued to fill their reserves ahead the end of the current two-week reserve period on October 15, keeping liquidity relatively tight after Thursday's tax payments, dealers said.
